name: groot_n17
description: GROOT N1.7 VLA — nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B (script: run.py; config=groot_n17, default embodiment oxe_droid_relative_eef_relative_joint)

run_options.name: prompt
run_options.default: put the blue block in the green bowl
run_options.help: Natural-language task instruction for the robot policy.

run_options.name: image
run_options.help: Comma-separated RGB image paths (one per camera view).

run_options.name: state
run_options.help: Optional .npz with state.* arrays for normalization and relative-action decode.

run_options.name: num_views
run_options.help: Number of camera views (oxe_droid_relative_eef_relative_joint uses 2; gr1_unified uses 2; libero_sim uses 2).

run_options.name: embodiment_tag
run_options.help: GROOT N1.7 embodiment slot. See flash_rt/models/groot_n17/embodiments.py for trained tags and view counts.

run_options.name: action_horizon
run_options.help: Number of action steps to generate (N1.7 default horizon is 40).

run_options.name: hardware
run_options.help: FlashRT backend: auto, rtx_sm89, rtx_sm120, thor.

run_options.name: use_fp8
run_options.help: Load policy weights in FP8 when supported.
